notes.title: Major Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed some achievements not being attainable
[*] Other UI bug fixes
[*] Other improvements
[/list]

[h1]New Content[/h1]

Many areas have been changed / reworked, with a brand new map layout.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nzQBrYQ.png[/img]

[h1]More Immersive Gameplay[/h1]

With the addition of a flashlight and true first person model, exploring the world is more immersive and realistic.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XJ68RO7.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C2aauLQ.png[/img]

[h1]Power System[/h1]

Some of the new locations require electricity for certain gameplay events. Switch the power back on and choose what to prioritize.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IjBCCkA.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gfd5SMy.png[/img]

[h1]Overview[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] UI improvements
[*] 5 new locations
[*] A new gun minigame
[*] More immersive & in-depth gameplay
[/list]
